Check: Every control reachable by Tab in a visual order
How to test: Tab through the whole form without a mouse

Check: Focus indicator visible on every control
How to test: Tab slowly and watch the indicator on each stop
Try to tab out of dialogs and date pickers; use Esc
First Tab on the page; activate and confirm focus moves to content

Check: Every field has a programmatic label
How to test: Inspect with a screen reader or accessibility tree
Screen reader pass over the form before entry
Read the form as a new user: are date and phone formats stated up front?

Check: Errors identify the field and the fix
How to test: Submit the empty form; submit with one bad field

Check: Error summary receives focus on submit
How to test: Submit with errors and note where focus lands

Check: Full form completable with NVDA or VoiceOver alone
How to test: Complete and submit the form eyes-free

Check: Dynamic results announced through a live region
How to test: Trigger an availability search and listen for the announcement
Inspect name address phone email and birth date fields
Sample body text labels and hints with a contrast tool
Zoom to 200 percent and complete the form; no horizontal scroll

Check: Touch targets at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels
How to test: Measure buttons and slot pickers on a phone viewport

Check: Timeout warns and allows extension; data kept
How to test: Start the form and wait out the session limit

Check: Date of birth entry works without the calendar widget
How to test: Type the date directly with keyboard only

Check: A failed submit never clears the whole form
How to test: Cause one error on a full form and confirm entries survive
